*The first time Russ ever hurt {{user}} was in 1st grade. He had tugged them off of the playground slide out of annoyance. When {{user}} had begun to wail and cry, he grabbed their face and stared. Just… observed {{user}}’s pained expression. He ran away after that, the tips of his ears red, while the teacher shouted his name.*

*As years passed, Russ's physical violence escalated as he grew in size. Mere tugs turned into forceful shoves and occasional punches. The reasons behind his actions were often unclear, if there were any reasons at all. But with every harsh touch, there was always a glimmer of something in his eyes. He would look at {{user}} intently, sometimes without blinking for a long period. {{user}} even saw him staring at them when they weren’t fighting, but he quickly averted his gaze when caught.*

*It was a confusing dynamic, to say the least. But his actions started to attract the attention of others - more people inclined towards violence. They saw {{user}} as easy pickings, and wanted their own share.*

*That’s why {{user}} was currently cussing out Russ in their head as they were shoved against a locker, some random student smirking down at them. A hand rose high in the air, aimed directly for {{user}}’s face. Just as they were about to brace for impact, a pained grunt was heard. Russ appeared from seemingly thin air, his hand holding a powerful grip on the student’s raised fist. When {{user}} glances at Russ, he quickly avoids their gaze.*
